title: "Manage user fields"
date: last-modified
---

Add your own fields to every user profile in your organization, such as Business Unit or Team. Users fill in their own values on their profile, and administrators can edit values from the User Directory.

User fields are free text and optional. They describe users only. You can't use them in filters, stakeholder pickers, workflows, attestations, or analytics. A user field called Business Unit is separate from the business units you set up for your organization.[^1]

::: {.attn}

## Prerequisites

- [x] {{< var link.login >}}
- [x] You are a [{{< fa hand >}} Customer Admin]{.bubble} or assigned another role with sufficient permissions to perform the tasks in this guide.[^2]

:::

## Add user fields

1. In the left sidebar, click **{{< fa gear >}} Settings**.

2. Under {{< fa users >}} Users & Access, select **User Fields**.

3. Click **{{< fa plus >}} Add User Field**.

4. Enter a **Label** for the field, such as `Business Unit`.

    Users see this label on their profile. Each label must be unique in your organization.

5. Click **Add User Field**.

The new field is added to the end of the list. It's empty for every user until someone enters a value.

Your organization can have up to 50 user fields.

## Rename user fields

1. On the User Fields page, click the field you want to rename, or click **{{< fa ellipsis-vertical >}}** next to it and select **Rename User Field**.

2. Enter the new **Label**.

3. Click **Rename User Field**.

Values users have already entered are kept.

## Reorder user fields

On the User Fields page, drag a field by its handle to a new position. The new order is saved when you drop the field.

User fields appear in this order on user profiles, in the User Directory, and on each user's detail page.

## Hide or show user fields

Hide a field to remove it from user profiles, the User Directory, and user detail pages without losing its values:

1. On the User Fields page, click **{{< fa ellipsis-vertical >}}** next to the field.

2. Select **Hide User Field**.

    The field is marked as Hidden in the list.

To bring the field and its values back, click **{{< fa ellipsis-vertical >}}** and select **Show User Field**.

## Delete user fields

::: {.callout-important title="Deleting a user field removes every value users have entered for it."}
To keep the values, hide the field instead.
:::

1. On the User Fields page, click **{{< fa ellipsis-vertical >}}** next to the field.

2. Select **Delete User Field**.

3. Click **Yes, Delete User Field** to confirm.

## Where user fields appear

Once you add a user field, it shows up in these places:

Your profile
: Each user can enter or change their own values on their profile, below Title.[^3]

User Directory
: Each field is available as a column you can turn on with Manage Columns. Search in the User Directory also matches user field values.[^4]

User detail page
: The values appear below the user's name and email. Administrators can edit them in place.[^4]
